email.subject: FW: Mechanical damage – Summit
email.body:
Accounting,

Please issue the back-charge described below to Harbor Mechanical. This is the first time I'm sending it over, so it hasn't been logged yet.

Thanks,
Dana

-----Original Message-----
From: Marco Silva, Field Superintendent
Subject: Damaged ceiling grid – Summit MOB

Dana,

Harbor Mechanical damaged the ceiling grid while moving ductwork above the second-floor corridor. The repair crew's cost came to $1,340.00. This needs to go back to Harbor.
